references.notes:
He \[(i.e. Smith)\] does not describe the oval precisely, but it touched the centre of Court XIX and passed over Court XLIX. We also have a plan, a very dirty tracing from Layard, which Smith must have used in the field: the letter G is marked in Rooms XXIX, XXXIV and XXXVIII–XXXIX and Court XLIX, which surround Rooms XL–XLI, perhaps indicating where his excavations
reached the floor.
